system.description:
Duergar (Gray Dwarf)

The duergar, or gray dwarves, are a subrace of dwarves corrupted long ago by mind flayer enslavement in the Underdark. They are pale-skinned with bald heads or iron-grey hair, sunken eyes, and a permanent expression of grim suspicion. Duergar have developed potent innate psionic abilities during their long servitude and retain a deep hatred for mind flayers. They are joyless, cruel, and usually lawful evil in alignment, building harsh slave-holding societies in the deep places of the world.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −2

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 90 feet.
  • Innate Spell-like Abilities: Once per day — enlarge (self only, usable at 3rd level) and invisibility (self only, usable at 5th level).
  • Magic Resistance: Duergar have a 20% resistance to magic spells. This increases with level.
  • Detect Stonework: Superior to mountain dwarves; detect grade on 1–5 in d6; traps on 1–4; depth underground on 1–4.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. orcs, half-orcs, goblins, and hobgoblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. giants, ogres, trolls, ogre magi, and titans.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +1 per 3.5 points of Constitution vs. magic and poison.
  • Light Sensitivity: Duergar suffer a −2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws in bright sunlight or the area of a continual light spell.
  • Psionics: Duergar possess psionic abilities at the DM's discretion.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Thief; Fighter/Thief multiclass. Usually NPC or with DM permission only.
